summary: End-to-end testing of the new Training Grounds feature. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_training.py covering the Pro gate (free user registered with ARENA-<redacted> gets 402 on GET /api/training and POST /api/training/{parse,complete,agent/step,save-crab}), overview shape (3 levels, 12 challenges, 4 per level, solution hidden, par exposed), local parser (`go right 4`, number words, multi-line), server-side simulation + star scoring (c1-first-steps 3 stars; c2-notched-pole full solve 3 stars; bogus actions on c3-warmup → success:false, stars:0), and input/validation caps (/parse 41 lines → 422, /complete invalid type → 422, /complete unknown id → 404, /agent/step instructions>1200 → 422, /agent/step actions>40 → 422). Frontend (admin, PRO): /training renders training-page with training-level-1..3, four challenge chips per level, training-goal-card, training-stage, 3D canvas (WebGL on), training-meter, Tips dialog with next+close that persists in localStorage. Level 1 Command: `go right 4` on c1-first-steps → log row 0 has 'local' badge, training-result shows 3 stars; `go right 4` on c1-mind-the-red → training-event-banner 'Stepped on a red danger tile.'; `move down two` then `go right 4` after reset → success; `dance a jig` → 'unclear' badge + 'The crab shrugs.' + three Did-you-mean suggestion-* buttons; clicking the first suggestion re-runs it with a 'local' badge. View toggle swaps to training-yard-2d (yard2d-tile-x-y + training-crab-2d). Level 2 Script: c2-notched-pole with the canonical 6-line script → 3 stars; replacing `grab notch 2` with `grab notch 3` → script-error 'Stopped at line 4: Notch 3 is empty.'. Regression smoke: Home, Arena, Leaderboard, Admin, Pricing all load and the nav shows nav-training-grounds. Mobile viewport 390x844 renders training-page and keeps command-input visible/usable. Cleanup: free test user deleted via DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}; ARENA access_codes.uses reset to 0 in Mongo.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/training.py POST /api/training/suggest is implemented but unused by the frontend (CommandPanel pulls suggestions from the /parse response's `suggestions` field directly). Either remove it or wire the AgentPanel/ScriptPanel to call it on parse errors to avoid dead code.

AgentPanel.start() always calls onFinished('agent') after the loop exits, even on error/timeout/step-cap paths. That is harmless (yard.live().status !== 'success' short-circuits the POST) but creates an extra React state write; consider only calling onFinished when the yard actually reached success.

stars_for() in backend/training.py awards 3 stars only when actions <= par AND stumbles == 0; the solution lists are already at par, so any run that hits a stumble (walking into a wall) can never reach 3 stars even if actions<=par — intentional, but worth documenting in the UI tooltip near training-meter so players understand why stumbles cost a star.

Session key `${ch.id}-${level}` resets the command log and local state when switching challenges, which is good for isolation. Minor: Tips dialog uses `useState(() => (localStorage.getItem(...) ? -1 : 0))` on mount so if the user clears localStorage mid-session, the tip won't come back until page reload — expected behavior, but worth a quick comment.
test_credentials: Admin (pro) and ARENA access code supplied via orchestrator shell env (TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL / TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD / TEST_ACCESS_CODE); NOT written to any file or memory. /app/memory/test_credentials.md intentionally absent.
